# Next-round schedule (generated by plan/make_plan.py; times are estimates)

Budget per job 5.2 h of the 6 h wall. GPU work 25.0 h, GPU+CPU work 4.6 h, CPU work 5.8 h. TC2 runs two jobs at once: pair one GPU job with one CPU job.

Submit each from the login node in ~/hift-stress:

```
sbatch --export=ALL,QUEUE=<queue file> slurm/job_queue_gpu_tc2.sbatch   # gpu and mix queues
sbatch --export=ALL,QUEUE=<queue file> slurm/job_queue_cpu_tc2.sbatch   # cpu queues
```
